_meta.how: Every bare import specifier found in the files listed in files.txt (import/export-from/dynamic import/require/CSS @import), mapped to Adcero's package.json range and the version package-lock.json actually resolved. 'range' is what to put in package.json; 'resolved' is the exact version Adcero runs today.
notes: Creative-engine follow-up (CREATIVE_MANIFEST.md, 2026-10-24): the 65 creative files appended to files.txt import NO new npm packages — their bare imports are zod, undici (via the image providers' safe fetch) and @supabase/supabase-js (type-only, strategy-sources.ts + live-facts.ts). Text-only mode needs no image SDK; @google/genai stays optional (only lib/llm/clients/gemini.ts, a stub). They also need no new stubs: the only cut point they reach is the existing lib/llm/clients.ts stub (they call openAIChatCompletion only).
undici is NOT a direct dependency in Adcero (it resolves transitively at 6.29.1); lib/video-fetch-utils.ts imports it, so the new project must declare it.

@supabase/supabase-js is imported by the processors (mostly `import type { SupabaseClient }`, plus the client you construct). Keep it if you run the processors unchanged against Supabase/PostgREST; drop it only if you rewrite the db layer.
@google/genai is only needed by video labelling (video-label.ts type imports + your lib/llm/clients/gemini.ts stub); drop it if you skip video labels.
sharp is used by services/job-processor/ad-library/label/media.ts for poster dimensions (aspect_ratio).
Install React-peered packages with `npm install --prefer-dedupe`: in Adcero a plain install produced duplicate Radix copies and broke dismiss-on-outside-click across Dialog/Popover/Select.
Not needed (only reached by the skipped classic overview or tailwind.config.ts): framer-motion, date-fns, tailwindcss-animate, @tailwindcss/typography.
Adcero's package.json `overrides` (react pins for @supabase/auth-ui-react and react-day-picker) are NOT needed: neither package is in files.txt.
